Text: The system must implement encryption protocols for all patient data both in transit and at rest to protect sensitive health information from unauthorized disclosure and interception.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall implement end-to-end encryption for all real-time GPS location data transmitted between mobile devices and the central fleet management server to prevent unauthorized interception of vehicle positions and driver movements.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall encrypt all data transmissions between mobile devices and the central server using TLS 1.3 or higher, ensuring that sensitive vehicle location data and maintenance records remain confidential during transmission across public and private networks.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall ensure that only authorized fleet managers with valid credentials can access vehicle location data and operational dashboards.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall implement role-based access control mechanisms to restrict customer access to only their own order history, personal information, and account details while preventing unauthorized viewing of other users' data.
Label: Security

Text: The system must provide end users with notifications whenever their personal health information is accessed by other authorized healthcare providers.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall enforce role-based access control (RBAC) to ensure that fleet drivers can only view and modify their assigned vehicle records and trip data, while fleet managers can access all vehicle and driver information, and administrators maintain full system access with audit capabilities.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall validate and sanitize all user input fields including search queries, report filters, and vehicle modification requests to prevent SQL injection, cross-site scripting (XSS), and command injection attacks from malicious users.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall maintain secure backups of all patient records with encryption and restricted access controls to ensure data recovery without compromising confidentiality.
Label: Security

Text: The system shall ensure that only authenticated drivers with valid credentials can access their assigned vehicle information and operational data
Label: Security
